name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, RET 0, returns this in EAX. Stores vtable 00CEAE54 and clears the two flag bytes at +4h (wanted) and +5h (active). Vtable slot +0 is __purecall and 004f71d0 calls it with no arguments and uses EAX as the registry index, so the leaf type supplies its own screen id. Known slots: +18h enter, +1Ch exit, +20h update(float), +24h the dependency list 004f83b0 reads. Chained by 00533120, the constructor of the 00425d10 menu command singleton.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_Destruct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, RET 0. Restores vtable 00CEAE54 and then scans the fixed registry 00E18B60..00E18CDB (95 pointer slots) clearing every slot that holds this. Counterpart of BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register 004f71d0.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, RET 0. Whole body is id = this->vtable[0](); *(00E18B60 + id*4) = this. The pure virtual at slot +0 returns the screen id, which is also the slot index BSP_FrontEndScreens_Pump 004f8830 walks.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall(float seconds), RET 4. Whole body is mov eax,[ecx]; fld [esp+4]; mov edx,[eax+20h]; push; fstp; call edx: the front-end screen base virtual +20h. Three callers. GGame::OnMove 004e4c88 passes the SCALED delta game+21F0h with ECX = the 00425d10 singleton; BSP_TitleScreen_Update 0068d873 passes the raw delta with ECX = title+40h. The same virtual slot is what BSP_FrontEndScreens_Pump calls in its update pass.

name: BSP_PriorityLists_GetTopPopulatedLevel
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl, no arguments, RET. Five checked vectors of 4-byte elements sit at 00e18cfc, 00e18d0c, 00e18d1c, 00e18d2c and 00e18d3c. The walk starts at the last with a counter of 5, steps back 10h at a time and returns the counter at the first non-empty vector, or 0 once it passes 00e18cfc. 004f7620 walks the same five with the same 1..5 numbering, resolves each element through the object table at &DAT_00e18b60 and latches the highest active level in DAT_00e08310, which fixes the base and the direction. Sole caller is the simulation gate at 004e5196, comparing the result against EDI = 1 with JG. What the levels rank is not established. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreens_Pump
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __stdcall(float raw_delta), RET 4, no ECX. Three callers; in GGame::OnMove 004e4ca3 it is the shared tail of states 1, 2 and 4. Guard: the 00425d10 singleton's byte +25Ch (modal dialog) narrows the body to that screen's virtual +20h and then returns unless game+1FE4h (local players) and 00E198C4 (mission) are both set. Otherwise clears the byte at 00E18CDC and makes three full passes over the 95 pointer slots 00E18B60..00E18CDB: exit (wanted==0 && active!=0 -> virtual +1Ch, then if still active clear active and run 004f83b0), enter (wanted!=0 && active==0 -> set active, 004f83b0, virtual +18h), update (both set -> virtual +20h with the raw delta).

name: BSP_Vector3f_Cross
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(out = ECX, a = EDX, b = [ESP+4]), RET 4, and leaves out in EAX, which 00BBD310 relies on when chaining. Standard right-handed cross product: out.x = a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, out.y = b.x*a.z - a.x*b.z, out.z = b.y*a.x - a.y*b.x. Used twice per axis by the ocean frame step. docs/GAME_WORLD_OCEAN.md.

name: BSP_Color_ConvertFloatRgbaToArgb
evidence: [BSP reconstruction] Scale each RGBA float by double255.0(00CE4B48), call runtime-selected extended-ST0 truncation00BF7420, clamp signed low32 to0..255, write R/G/B/A to bytes2/1/0/3. Original ABI: ECX destination color; stack source float4; EAX destination; RET4. See docs/CAMERA_FRAME_STATE.md; typed interface, not native layout/ABI. Evidence: docs/CAMERA_FRAME_STATE.md; reports/camera_frame_state_audit.json. Descriptive names are hypotheses; typed interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.
